title: Live UK odds board
description: Odds & Value now compares active model players with live Bet365 and Sky Bet prices, while Player Drilldown adds archived opening and closing odds where available.

title: Last week’s betting P/L
description: The homepage now groups realised profit and loss by tournament and backed player for the latest settled week.

title: Clearer page navigation
description: Breadcrumbs now keep tournament, player, course, archive, and betting pages connected with contextual back-links.

title: Improved iPhone usability
description: PGA and DP World leaderboards now keep wide tables inside a smooth swipe area, with larger touch targets on iPhone and iPad.
